column1: # Jurisdictions no codifier API resolves, researched by hand and recorded here.
# This file is the part of the dataset no API produces, so it is committed.
# Manual rows override the API for every column they fill.
# THREE SOURCES ARE REPRESENTED. American Legal Publishing and General Code
# refuse scripted requests and were read in a browser. MunicipalCodeOnline was
# found only because three Municode client records pointed nowhere; it serves
# every subdomain a shell, so each was confirmed by the Florida address printed
# on the tenant's own page. A same-named Greenwood resolved to Wisconsin and was
# rejected on that test. Everything else was read from the jurisdiction's own
# website on the date in source_checked_date.
